announcements.title: DOE Identifies 16 Federal Sites Across the Country for Data Center and AI Infrastructure Development
announcements.status_text: Request for information; 16 potential sites identified
announcements.summary: DOE opened an RFI on potential AI infrastructure development at 16 federal sites. The release states a target of operations by end 2027; it does not establish construction or an awarded lease.

announcements.title: DOE Announces Site Selection for AI Data Center and Energy Infrastructure Development on Federal Lands
announcements.status_text: Four sites selected to invite private-sector proposals
announcements.summary: DOE selected INL, Oak Ridge Reservation, Paducah and Savannah River to proceed toward solicitations for data centers and energy generation. This is selection of federal sites for development proposals.

announcements.title: Energy Department Announces Partnership to Ensure Affordable Energy and Power America’s AI Future
announcements.summary: DOE and Commerce announced SoftBank/AEP Ohio redevelopment at Portsmouth. SB Energy planned 10 GW of new generation supporting a 10 GW data center development and committed $4.2 billion to transmission upgrades.

announcements.title: NNSA Selects Amentum for AI Data Center and Energy Project at Savannah River Site
announcements.summary: NNSA selected Amentum to negotiate a proposed 1 GW data center and approximately 2 GW of on-site generation at Savannah River. A final lease and required approvals remained outstanding.

announcements.title: Energy Department Announces Partnership to Expand Reliable, Affordable Energy Access and Power America’s AI Future in Western Kentucky
announcements.status_text: Developers selected; power service agreement pending PSC approval
announcements.summary: DOE announced Brookfield as developer/operator of the proposed 1.8 GW Paducah campus and NextEra as owner/builder of dedicated generation and storage. The release targets construction completion in 2031.

announcements.title: Energy Secretary Prepares to Unleash Backup Generation Ahead of Winter Storm Fern
announcements.status_text: Prepared emergency action and draft order; no site-specific deployment announced
announcements.summary: DOE asked grid operators to prepare data center and other major-facility backup generation for last-resort use during Winter Storm Fern. This is a national grid-reliability action.

coverage_notes: 17 national-laboratory organizations (20 reference locations) and all 16 entries on DOE’s EM map are represented. Three shared lab/EM locations give 33 distinct points.

NETL laboratory coordinates cite a 2014 source. EM coordinates come from DOE’s current public map. Points mark published reference locations, including field offices; they are not campus boundaries or development parcels.
Unmapped lab satellites: NLR Flatirons and Fairbanks; Sandia Tonopah, Kauai and Science & Technology Park. Verified public coordinates are not available in this dataset.

Other unmapped assets include Kansas City National Security Campus, Pantex, Y-12, Naval Nuclear Laboratory sites, East Tennessee Technology Park and the Separations Process Research Unit. Power Marketing Administration infrastructure, Strategic Petroleum Reserve facilities and legacy-management sites are not comprehensively covered.
The April 2025 RFI and January 2026 Winter Storm Fern backup-generation action are national announcements without individual project pins.
